description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android application, which displays a grid of products with a search functionality, including interactions for viewing product details and adding products to a cart.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a grid of products with search functionality and handles interactions such as viewing details and adding to cart.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view hierarchy for the fragment, sets up RecyclerView, search listener, and click listeners.

methods.name: loadProducts
methods.description: Loads products from the repository based on the search query and updates the adapter.

methods.name: openDetails
methods.description: Starts the ProductDetailActivity with the selected product's ID.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds the specified product to the shopping cart asynchronously.
